SHOT: A worn photograph: the model's forearm lying across her body, the wrist forward and square to camera, the bracelet large and legible in frame. 4:5 vertical, full bleed.

CROP: The frame is cut straight across just ABOVE THE UPPER LIP. NO eyes, NO eyebrows, NO forehead anywhere in this picture. Inside the frame: chin, neck, collarbones, shoulder, forearm and hand.

THE PRODUCT: IMAGE 1 is the supplier photograph and the ONLY authority on what this piece is: copy its construction, its metal colour and its stone colour EXACTLY; it is a crop of the supplier photo: the bracelet lies on white with a pink code label in the middle and parts of a matching necklace at the edges: take ONLY the bracelet; ignore the label and the necklace at the edges. IMAGE 2 is our approved packshot of this exact piece: the authority on its size, proportions, metal colour and finish; the piece in this picture must match it exactly. IMAGE 3 is the authority on the model, skin, garment, hair, ground and light: match it exactly, but she wears ONLY the piece from IMAGE 1, worn on ONE wrist; any other jewellery in IMAGE 3 is removed.

THE PLATE: A young Indian woman, late twenties, warm mid-brown skin with golden undertones. Long dark brown hair in loose natural waves. Bare shoulders, marigold-saffron silk camisole with narrow spaghetti straps. Nails short, bare, pale nude, no polish colour. Warm cream seamless with a gentle gradient falloff, never sand, tan, beige or golden. Soft large key from camera-left, one soft shadow.

CONSTRUCTION LOCK: A COLOURED STATION BRACELET with EXACTLY SEVEN small faceted stones, each in its own thin polished gold bezel, on a fine gold cable chain, ALTERNATING between stones set IN the chain and stones HANGING below it. In order from one end: a pale green ROUND stone set in the chain; a lilac CUSHION stone hanging as a drop; a yellow ROUND stone set in the chain; a pink PEAR stone hanging as a drop, point up; a blue ROUND stone set in the chain; a pale green OVAL stone hanging as a drop; a purple ROUND stone set in the chain. The stretch of chain on either side of the lobster clasp, about a third of the bracelet, is PLAIN chain with no stones at all; a short extender chain hangs from the clasp. Exactly seven stones in total, four set in the chain and three hanging, never eight or more, never two drops side by side; the plain stretch by the clasp carries no stone; mixed pastel colours only, no clear stones, no pearls, no clusters; one fine chain.

SCALE TEST: On the wrist the drops hang below a fine thread of chain, each smaller than a fingernail. The jewellery keeps its true small size against the body; it is read by bringing the camera closer, never by making the piece bigger.

ABSENCE LIST: No eyes, no eyebrows, no forehead. No second piece of jewellery, no watch, no other rings, no other earrings, no necklace unless it is the product. No nail polish colour. No props, no flowers. Metal: warm 18k gold tone, never brassy, orange or greenish. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. No border, no frame, no paper edge, no vignette: the image fills the whole frame edge to edge. A clean modern digital photograph: no creases, no fold lines, no aged-paper texture, no scratches, no film grain.
